topic: Deploying dashboard changes from stage to production
summary_markdown: The conversation focused on deploying recent changes made by someone to a dashboard. The initial discussion clarified that the goal was not data migration, but rather transferring front-end logic/updates from the staging (stage) environment to the production (prod) environment. [me] confirmed understanding of the scope and proceeded with the deployment.
decisions: Front-end changes made on stage will be deployed to prod.
